itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter9_verse4.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9 Verse 4
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter9_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 9 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter9_verse4.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9, Verse 4 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter9_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
